newsitem.title: UK: Wolverhampton & Dudley profits in line.
newsitem.headline: Wolverhampton & Dudley profits in line.

text.p: Britain's Wolverhampton & Dudley Breweries Plc said on Wednesday that despite margin pressures turnover had strengthened and group profitability for the year to date was in line with expectations.

In a trading update for the first 47 weeks of the year, the group said trading over the summer months had been strong, with turnover so far up 7.4 percent compared with growth of 6.1 percent for continuing businesses in the first 26 weeks.
Beer and cider volumes overall were 1.7 percent stronger, the same as in the first half of the year.
The group said margins continued to be under pressure in its wholesale business but were slightly higher in the second half than in the first six months.
Retail margins had also improved, but the brewery said costs of operation were higher than last year because it was investing in higher service standards.
